title: Qwen 3.6 MoE, gated DeltaNet hybrid with routed and shared experts (35B-A3B, Ornith 35B)

installs.name: qwen36-ane-experiment
installs.note: the install on this host; the catalog's Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B rows are the same shape

recommended.why: auto takes the Steel 64-row micro-batch: 1.42-1.56x prefill over the per-token loop; its KL against per-token is 2.55e-3 to 3.94e-3, a hundred times the dense arm, which is why this family's class is moe_kl

the batched routed half pays at 32 or more slots (1.65x prefill at 96 slots, 88 to 145 tok/s) and is worth 2.5% at 16; it is opt-in until its default owes the seam-on probe, the memory oracle, Ornith and a second chip
auto resolves to 96 slots on this host, which is where the routed batch pays; 16 slots keeps the footprint near 1.6 GiB at the cost of prefill
default on; qwen_moe_chunked_refusal names the reasons it falls back (hadamard, the read-overlap seam, an open drafter), and capabilities reports the conditional
JIT warmup stays opt-in: docs/MOE_STARTUP.md measured the startup cost it moves and decided the default

overlapping the next sub-batch's expert pread with the GPU
